cutoff_rule: This is an observed planning inventory, not the parent canonical cutoff. Rehash exactly listed paths at the agreed cutoff; preserve later peer edits and report them as outside that snapshot. Moving files require a fresh binding, not a blanket git add.

public_index_projections.instruction: Only project the Git index at canonical cutoff; preserve local original. Prompt projection is a no-op when equal to HEAD.

privacy_scan.scope: Every nonbinary changed path in this snapshot, limited patterns only; no values emitted. No image/OCR, semantic PII or credential-store inspection.

ignored_runtime_private.rule: Keep ignored credentials, Wrangler/runtime caches, node_modules, browser captures/login files and sourcing research exports local. Do not force-add. Immutable run receipts are project evidence, not automatically a cache; no blanket runs-directory deletion or exclusion.
